metadata.name: etchy_bridge
metadata.description: Etchy Rune bridge: lock vault between Etchy SPL coins and Bitcoin Runes

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Admin transfer, step 2.

instructions.name: bridge_to_rune
docs: Holder: lock tokens and request the real Rune at a Taproot address.
`btc_witness_program` is the 32-byte segwit-v1 program of a bc1p address.
`request_id` is any client-chosen number unique for this user (random);
it keeps concurrent requests from different users independent.

instructions.name: bridge_to_rune_2022
docs: Holder: `bridge_to_rune` for a Token-2022 coin.

instructions.name: close_withdrawal
docs: Holder: close a finished (Sent or Refunded) request and get its rent back.

instructions.name: enable_rune
docs: Admin: link the coin to its Rune once the etch is FINAL on Bitcoin.
Bridging (both ways) is impossible before this, and the Rune ID can
never be changed afterwards.

accounts.name: program
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize (no front-running).

instructions.name: mark_withdrawal_sent
docs: Attester: the Rune was sent on Bitcoin (records the txid, final state).

instructions.name: pause
docs: Admin or guardian: pause everything (fast incident response).

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Admin transfer, step 1 (the new admin must accept).

instructions.name: refund_withdrawal
docs: Attester: the Rune could not be sent; return the locked tokens to the
requester's own wallet (its canonical token account, re-created if the
user closed it). Final state; exclusive with Sent.

instructions.name: refund_withdrawal_2022
docs: Attester: `refund_withdrawal` for a Token-2022 coin.

instructions.name: register_mint
docs: Admin: register an Etchy coin. The mint must be an Etchy coin: 6
decimals, no mint and no freeze authority, supply at most the 10^15
Rune premine (it can only shrink, by burns, so the Rune backing in
custody always covers every token).

instructions.name: register_mint_2022
docs: Admin: register a Token-2022 Etchy coin. Same shape as `register_mint`,
and its mint may carry nothing but its own metadata (no transfer fee,
hook, permanent delegate, close authority, pause, ...): nothing can
tax, block or take the vault's tokens. A mint's extensions are fixed
when it is created, so this check holds for the coin's whole life.

instructions.name: release_deposit
docs: Attester: release tokens for a FINAL Rune deposit to Etchy custody.
The receipt PDA (coin, txid, vout) makes every outpoint single-use.

instructions.name: release_deposit_2022
docs: Attester: `release_deposit` for a Token-2022 coin (same receipt PDA:
every Bitcoin outpoint is still single-use).

instructions.name: set_mint_limits
docs: Admin: per-coin limits.

instructions.name: set_mint_paused
docs: Admin: pause/unpause a single coin.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Admin only: unpause.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin: rotate keys / fee (attester rotation is the compromise response).

errors.name: NotEnabled
errors.msg: Rune not enabled for this coin (etch not final yet)

errors.name: NotAnEtchyCoin
errors.msg: Mint is not an Etchy coin (6 decimals, supply <= 10^15, no mint/freeze authority)

errors.name: WrongRefundAccount
errors.msg: Refund must go to the requester's own wallet

errors.name: UnsupportedTokenExtension
errors.msg: Token-2022 coin with an extension other than its own metadata

errors.name: TransferAmountMismatch
errors.msg: Token transfer moved a different amount

fields.name: rune_block
docs: Rune ID `block:tx` (set once, when the etch is final).

fields.name: seq
docs: Per-coin order of requests (the attester processes in this order).
